newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish NTMA to auction 100 mln punts of bond due 20.
newsitem.headline: Irish NTMA to auction 100 mln punts of bond due 20.

text.p: Ireland's National Treasury Management Agency (NTMA) on Thursday announced that it will auction 100 million punts of the 8.25 percent bond due 2015 on May 20.
The auction will be confined to primary dealers.
The NTMA also announced a non-competitive auction confined to primary dealers of up to 20 million punts following the competitive auction.
